The MX-0402-MST Conference Presentation Switcher is the ultimate solution for modern conference rooms. Designed to simplify and enhance your presentation experience, this 4x2 switcher integrates video, audio, USB, control, and Ethernet functionalities. With dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, automatic switching capabilities, and advanced USB 3.2 ports, the MX-0402-MST ensures seamless connectivity and control for all your conference needs. Experience crystal-clear 4K video, high-speed data transfer, and efficient power delivery with this state-of-the-art presentation switcher.

The MX-0402-MST Conference Presentation Switcher features dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, allowing for versatile connectivity. Each input port supports cable lock connections, ensuring secure and stable connections for your presentation devices.

Experience the full potential of USB-C with support for 4K video, USB 3.2 data transfer, and 60W charging. The MX-0402-MST also supports dual video output via a single USB-C cable, providing exceptional flexibility for multi-screen presentations.

formats: PCM, Dolby and DTS format support

interfaces: Dual RJ-45 ports support Ethernet switching and VLAN settings, providing reliable network connectivity and enhanced security.
